meta_data.base_class: retrieve the latest net worth data of a given <celebrity type> - categories of public figures distinguished by their primary field of fame

tool_template.name: <class>_net_worth.get
tool_template.description: Get the total net worth of a <class> based on most recent data.

currency.description: The currency in which the net worth will be returned, e.g., 'USD', 'CNY'.

include_assets.description: Flag to include detailed asset information in the net worth calculation of the <class>.

tax_adjusted.description: Specify whether the net worth of the <class> should be calculated post-tax.

net_worth_history.description: Flag to include historical net worth data trends for the <class>.

data_source.description: Identifier for the source of data used to calculate the net worth of the <class>, e.g., 'Forbes', 'Financial Times'.

verification_level.description: The level of verification required for the net worth data of the <class>, e.g., 'basic', 'medium', 'high'.
